title: louislva/claude-peers-mcp — Allow all your Claude Codes to message each other ad-hoc!

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if AI systems could communicate freely, like a decentralized network of minds? How would that reshape collaboration and innovation?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: With tools like louislva/claude-peers-mcp, Claude models can now message each other ad-hoc, enabling real-time coordination across distributed tasks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But allowing AI to message freely risks unintended influence, bias propagation, and the blurring of accountability in complex, interconnected systems.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are embedding guardrails, like message logging and access controls, to ensure transparency and prevent misuse in peer-to-peer AI communication.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where ethical AI systems collaborate seamlessly, solving global challenges through shared knowledge and aligned values.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about capability—it’s about crafting systems that evolve with responsibility, trust, and human-centric design.

video_cue: A network of glowing nodes communicating across a dark, digital landscape, symbolizing interconnected AI systems working in harmony.
